neighbors: Buffy the Vampire Slayer Season Eight
edges: Joss Whedon produced the comic series and wrote or co-wrote three of the series arcs.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The comic series serves as a canonical continuation of the television series.
Season Nine followed the conclusion of the comic series.
The absence of an eighth season is said to prevent dilution and disappointment.
The series is described as a perfect tapestry of storytelling, reflecting the essence of beloved characters.

edges: Joss Whedon consistently declared that the narrative was neatly wrapped up in the seventh season.
